description.value: ArtSpring is Salt Spring Island's premier community performing and visual arts centre, occupying an 11,800 sq ft heavy timber building with a 259-seat theatre and a 5,200 sq ft gallery and multi-purpose space. Opened in 1999, it hosts around 300 events annually—from local community productions to international touring artists, gallery exhibitions, and workshops—making it the cultural hub of the Gulf Islands. Cycling visitors to Salt Spring Island will find it a compelling stop for live music, dance, theatre, and visual art in one of BC's most scenic island communities.

address.value: 100 Jackson Avenue, Salt Spring Island, V8K 2V8
